x: The day was blessed with fine weather, and the traditionally high standard of marking set by 'Harry', the late groundsman, had obviously had been maintained by his successors.
Oh Harry, I almost forgot you.

Cross-country hasn't really featured in her career so far but as the Surrey road racing series has underlined, we do have the ability to make a mark in team races and Helen admits to be "expecting to get roped in". No doubt Harry is reaching for the 'phone this very minute!

What names there are to recall in that piece - Harry Hicks became a team mate in 1956, Gordon Pirie a friend from the same time and then Walter Hesketh who was a Fascist election candidate for the area I was responsible for in Manchester!
